endorsements.quote: At the organizational level, we recommend the establishment of digital health advisory committees and the implementation of robust governance structures to improve physician engagement.
Thus, exploring ways to have dedicated resourcing and remuneration to support the long-term engagement of physicians in digital health initiatives will be essential.

Lastly, as digital tools continue to become a critical aspect of the Canadian health care environment, engagement and continued input from frontline physicians, other clinicians, and patients will only grow in importance.

unlisted_practices: Establish national funding strategies to sustain digital health and AI initiatives and promote equitable access to resources.
Develop a national standardized digital health toolkit adaptable to primary care, community care, and hospital settings.
Implement a comprehensive digital health curriculum to train new physicians and provide ongoing education for current practitioners.
Include workflow ease and administrative burden as mandatory criteria when evaluating and implementing digital health tools.
Establish physician champions on leadership committees for digital health and AI initiatives.

screen.reason: This is a framework/recommendations paper synthesizing an environmental scan and case studies to provide organizational strategies and governance recommendations for adopting AI scribes to support physician wellness.
